text: The Cyclone Reinsurance Pool, managed by the Australian Reinsurance Pool Corporation (ARPC), mandates participation from Australian general insurers to provide reinsurance for cyclone-related risks. The initiative aims to improve insurance affordability and availability in cyclone-prone regions through centralized, cost-neutral reinsurance pricing. PACE Cyclone is the digital portal used for insurer onboarding and ongoing participation.
